text: dsh-session-eva-status 是 DSH 网页侧栏会话状态装饰插件。它读取 DSH 的会话与工作区状态，为待处理、当前选中和完成未读的会话行添加彩色左轨，并给未归档的置顶会话标题加彩虹渐变。状态变化或侧栏行更新时会同步标记；归档会话和仍有子智能体运行的会话不会被标为未读。适合想快速辨认会话状态的用户。代码未显示额外 API 密钥或运行时外部服务。

dsh-session-eva-status decorates the DSH web sidebar using official session state. It adds colored rails for pending, selected, and completed unread sessions, plus rainbow titles for pinned sessions. It requires no extra API key or runtime external service in the inspected code.
想让 DSH 侧栏用颜色区分需要我处理的会话。
DSH 能不能把置顶会话标题显示成彩虹色？
I want to spot unread completed sessions in the DSH sidebar at a glance.
dsh-session-eva-status 的功能「侧栏状态着色」：为待处理交互、当前选中和完成未读的会话行分别设置状态标记，并用左侧色轨显示；通过状态订阅和行变化同步更新。
dsh-session-eva-status 的功能「置顶会话彩虹标题」：为未归档的置顶会话行设置标记，再将标题文字显示为彩虹渐变；当工作区状态变化时更新。

dsh-session-eva-status README · dsh-session-eva-status：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Colors DSH sidebar Session rows by their **official** UI status, in an Evangelion-flavored palette. The plugin owns no state: it reads facts the Client already has, writes one `data-` attribute per row, and styles that attribute from a single injected stylesheet.

dsh-session-eva-status README · dsh-session-eva-status：| Row state | Official fact it reads | Decoration |
|---|---|---|
| Pending interaction (approval / question / plan review) | `uiSession.sessionStatus.pendingInteraction` | blue full-height left rail + 1.6 s breathing. Two blues, one per mode, both from card C ("Newtype" cover): dark `#AAC7EF`, light `#3F629C` |
| Selected — the session open in the main view | `sessions.list` snapshot: `retainedBy.mainView > 0` | red full-height left rail, static. Two reds, one per mode: dark keeps `#FF3B30`, light overrides it with the redder, deeper `#E01B24` |
| Finished but not viewed | `…sessionStatus.completionUnread` | purple `#7A4FD6` full-height left rail |
| Pinned | `workspaces.list` snapshot: `pinnedSessionIds` | the row title becomes a static six-color rainbow (`background-clip: text`); the row itself gets no rail. Two palettes, one per mode: dark keeps the original six, light uses a darker six solved to ≥4.5:1 against the light wall |
| Running / subagents running / idle / archived / blank | — | nothing drawn; the official spinner and archived dimming already say it |

dsh-session-eva-status README · dsh-session-eva-status：The official priority is pending > running > subagents > completed. When a session has finished but its subagents are still running, the official row shows the ongoing spinner, so this plugin draws nothing and lets that spinner through instead of calling the row "finished".

dsh-session-eva-status README · dsh-session-eva-status：The plugin's own priority is pending > selected > subagents (yields) > unread. A row that needs you outranks the row you happen to be looking at, and a selected row keeps its red rail while its subagents run — the official spinner is not hidden on selected rows, so both readings stay visible at once.

dsh-session-eva-status README · dsh-session-eva-status：The design rule behind the palette: **shape carries meaning, color and light carry style.** The pin icon and the pinned-first ordering stay entirely official — only the pinned row's title text is re-colored, so the pin itself is never restyled or decorated.

dsh-session-eva-status README · dsh-session-eva-status：The rainbow is mode-scoped, because the same mid-luminance stops do not survive both backgrounds: on the light theme's wall (measured luminance 0.405–0.658 under the pinned titles) the original six score only 1.15–3.63:1, while on the dark theme's wall they are fine. Dark therefore keeps the original six colours unchanged, and light uses six darker stops of the same hues in the same order, each clearing 4.5:1 against the darkest patch measured under the title. The split is read from DSH's own dark marker (`body[data-ds-dark-theme]`, `theme-presenter.ts`), not from any theme-specific hook.

dsh-session-eva-status README · dsh-session-eva-status：The pending rail is mode-scoped for the same reason. Its blue comes from card C (the "Newtype" cover reference), which carries two blues: `#3F629C` (slate blue — 5.84:1 on the light wall but only 2.82:1 on the dark one) and `#AAC7EF` (pale blue — 9.94:1 on the dark wall but only 1.66:1 on the light one). Neither survives both, so each mode takes the one that reads on its own wall: light `#3F629C`, dark `#AAC7EF`. Both tiers share one `@keyframes`: the rail reads its colour through a custom property (`--dsh-session-eva-status-pending`), and the light rule overrides only that property, so the breathing period, easing and low point stay byte-for-byte identical and only the colour changes.

dsh-session-eva-status README · dsh-session-eva-status：The selected rail is mode-scoped for the same reason. `#FF3B30` keeps a high green channel (59) and scores only 3.39:1 on the light wall; light overrides the colour alone with the redder, deeper `#E01B24` — hue rotated past pure red (HSL 357.3°), green cut from 59 to 27 — which clears 4.62:1. Dark is byte-for-byte unchanged. The override is one extra rule scoped by `body:not([data-ds-dark-theme])` that sets `background` and nothing else, so the rail's geometry, stacking and lack of animation are untouched.

dsh-session-eva-status README · Install：From the npm registry:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-session-eva-status
```

Or straight from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:WhatCannotBeSaid/dsh-session-eva-status
```

Replace `<profile>` with the target profile name (for example `web`), then **restart DSH**: the client bundle is only refreshed when the module graph is recomposed, so a plain page refresh hits the old cache.

dsh-session-eva-status README · Install：Working from a checkout instead? Point the CLI at the directory — the package also installs as a plain Profile dependency listed in that profile's `package.json` and `dsh.bundles`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <path-to>/dsh-session-eva-status
```
dsh-session-eva-status README · Config：The shipped `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the entry with these defaults; edit them there.

dsh-session-eva-status README · Config：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `hideOfficialDot` | `true` | Hide the official status dot on pending and unread rows (their left rail replaces it) |
| `breatheMs` | `1600` | Breathing period for the pending rail (ms, ≥ 200) |
| `colors` | EVA palette | Override `pending` / `pendingLight` / `selected` / `selectedLight` / `unread`. `pending` and `selected` are the dark-mode values; `pendingLight` and `selectedLight` are the light-mode overrides |
dsh-session-eva-status README · Config：A malformed config throws at load; nothing is silently skipped.

dsh-session-eva-status README · How it works：- **Row anchor**: `[data-row-key="session:<id>"]` — rendered by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace`.
- **Title anchor**: the pinned rainbow is applied to the row's **second child**. The leading 16 px cell is always rendered, so the title's position in the row is stable and no hashed CSS-module class name has to be matched.
- **Status source**: `ctx.uiSession.sessionStatus`, the Client's own `HostObservable<ReadonlyMap<SessionId, SessionStatus>>` (`running`, `pendingInteraction`, `completionUnread`), plus `ctx.sessions.list` for two more official facts: the subagent catalog that decides the official "subagents running" state, and `retainedBy.mainView > 0` — the same fact the official row's own `selected` flag is computed from. The pinned set comes from `ctx.workspaces.list` (`pinnedSessionIds`). No polling, no event sniffing, no host half.
- **Row paint**: the state is carried by a single `::before` pseudo-element rail, and the row's own background is left completely alone — so official hover and selection feedback is untouched. The rail is deliberately **not** an `inset box-shadow`: an inset shadow is a band hugging the border's inner

dsh-session-eva-status README · Known limitations：- Hiding the official dot uses `> :first-child` on the row. In a pending or unread row that 16 px cell holds only the status dot (the `sidebar.session.row.leading` seat renders only while the row is idle), so nothing else is affected today — a future DSH that puts another occupant there would have it hidden too.
- Archived rows are left alone: the official UI already dims their title, and an archived row shows no status dot there anyway.
- The selected rail is an addition **on top of** the official selection highlight (the row's own background), not a replacement for it.
- The pinned rainbow is text-only (`background-clip: text`), so it needs no extra DOM: nothing is inserted into the row, and uninstalling removes the attribute and the rule together.
- The palette is deliberately theme-independent (EVA colors, not theme brand colors) and no row background is tinted. Every colour comes from that one palette; where a single value cannot clear both walls, the mode that needs it takes the sibling stop instead — that is the case for the pending blue (two card C blues, one per wall) and the selected red (a redder, deeper light-tier red),
